description:
New ThousandIsland.Transport implementation for SSL over Tailscale.

Uses Erlang :ssl with cb_info option pointing to GenTailscale:

  cb_info: {GenTailscale, :tailscale, :tailscale_closed, :tailscale_error, :tailscale_passive}

Module structure:
  - listen/2: calls :ssl.listen with cb_info + user SSL opts (certfile, keyfile, etc.)
  - accept/1: delegates to :ssl.transport_accept
  - handshake/1: calls :ssl.handshake
  - send/recv/close/etc: delegate to :ssl
  - sockname/peername: delegate to :ssl
  - secure?/0: returns true
  - peercert/1: delegates to :ssl
  - negotiated_protocol/1: delegates to :ssl
  - connection_information/1: delegates to :ssl

Depends on GenTailscale implementing the full cb_info contract.

comments.text: Sketch complete: lib/tailscale_transport/ssl.ex (~120 lines). Uses :ssl with cb_info pointing to GenTailscale. Almost identical structure to ThousandIsland's built-in SSL transport.

title: Implement TailscaleTransport.SSL
